scope: Both adb mode-guidance and session-lifecycle FRs; sudohand migration stays parked.

audit.naming: Core exports, module filenames and CLI names match; reconnect/restart join the existing browser lifecycle family.
audit.parameters: Core signatures/docstrings drive actual --help and generated wrappers. Existing start/connect arguments remain compatible; page calls take the same connection-scoped --session-id.
audit.discovery: Start/connect first lines distinguish isolated launch from attaching real Chrome. One shared core guidance covers headless task selection, explicit/env/default precedence, GUI prerequisites, real device identity, same-page collaboration and absence of viewer/relay.
audit.returns: Legacy result fields remain. Observed session/profile identity, actual headless mode where known, ownership and capabilities are additive. Opaque automation_target_id is distinct from zero-based targets.index. External physical process fields remain null when unknown.
audit.failures: Stable unsupported=6, conflict/session_changed=5, target_closed/not_found=4, auth_failed=7, transient=9. Hints come from core Failure sections. No implicit transport/profile fallback or input replay.
audit.sync_async: Async connect/reconnect use wrap_core; sync start/disconnect/stop/restart use wrap_core_sync. An async SDK caller with a held CDP connection awaits browser.close on its own loop.
audit.generation: 63 generated tools; generator reports zero changes after regeneration. Integration scenarios are generated with integration-test-generator, then linted/formatted.
audit.composition: Reuses Chrome spawn, BrowserClient, page navigation/input and bridge. Two additional lifecycle primitives manage process/identity state that in-page JS cannot express.
audit.paid_model_limits: Four final workflows passed using real credentials and Chrome, names/first lines and actual help in isolated model context. This is observed workflow success, not a promise of perfect choices across all model runs.

capability_bounds.already_running_extension: Connect preserves Chrome/profile/unrelated tabs. It identifies actual extension profile and browser-run UUID; no attempt to infer unknown OS PID/path or change running headless mode.
capability_bounds.external_restart: Explicit authorization is required; unknown executable/start settings still return unsupported.
capability_bounds.extension_launch: Requires a persistently installed/enabled bridge in the specified existing profile. No remote-debugging or command-line extension loading flags. Busy profile conflicts without killing it.
capability_bounds.slow_handshake: Keeps the launched browser running, reports resources and persists its observed process identity. A later handshake on the nonce URL restores ownership.
capability_bounds.remote: Page images/input are available to hosts. Viewer, relay and cloud pairing are outside these FRs.

retained_failed_attempts.location_8_bootstrap: Command-line/pipe extension loads are ephemeral and do not prove persistent installation. Acceptance switched to the actual Chrome management UI/native folder picker and verifies installed path.
retained_failed_attempts.native_ui: UIA Invoke generated repeated trusted clicks; switched to one physical mouse click in a separate main-thread desktop actor.
retained_failed_attempts.readiness: Early interaction runs were inconsistent; live flows now await server-backed logged-in state before input, with actual HTTP attempts retained.
retained_failed_attempts.cold_launch: A plain WebSocket endpoint could turn the nonce URL into a failed navigation before a cold worker observes it. The bridge now serves a stable HTML launch landing.
retained_failed_attempts.model_harness: A valid page_html choice was excluded by the early executor allow-list; the actual read tool is now allowed. Reports remain in scratch/lifecycle-model-existing-20261012.
retained_failed_attempts.visible_strict_check: An earlier visible run reported the existing documented synthetic click fallback and failed the strict trusted-submission assertion. The final unchanged input primitive completed a trusted single submission. The failed run remains at scratch/lifecycle-model-visible-ready-20261012; no assertion was weakened.
retained_failed_attempts.process_exit: A live restart trial observed the old process after its debug port closed. Graceful close now waits for observed process identity to end; restart separately refuses to launch while the old process remains.
retained_failed_attempts.early_worker_hello: A worker can announce connected before observing the nonce-marked tab. Connect now waits for a pending launch identity on that specific bridge before classifying ownership.
retained_failed_attempts.visible_extension: Earlier headful trials acknowledged input without a server-side action, including a sequential run. Explicit startup now activates its dedicated page. A later diagnostic captured the actual trusted mousedown/up/click at the correct DOM coordinates; final 9-case acceptance includes an event log and authenticated server receipts. These observations do not establish a universal fix for all Chrome input timing; earlier failures remain at scratch/lifecycle-sequential-final-20261013.
